title: Number of Islands
statement: Given a grid of land and water cells, count how many disconnected land regions exist. Cells connect vertically and horizontally.

editor_note.idea: Whenever an unvisited land cell is found, run DFS to mark the whole island and increment the count once.
editor_note.data_structure_reason: DFS explores one connected component completely before moving on.
editor_note.space_complexity: O(m * n) in the worst recursive case
editor_note.pitfalls: If visited cells are not marked, the same island gets counted multiple times.
